@graph.description: Experiment entry as a flat .eln Dataset: experiments are Datasets and direct children of the root (no Process as mainEntity, no nested Datasets; cf. TheELNFileFormat and ELN issue 116). The .eln projection of the OO-LD Time instance uses the schema.org branch of the validated QuantityValue mappings: variableMeasured/PropertyValue with schema:value and the URL form of schema:unitCode. The crate context stays pure RO-Crate 1.1, since layering the OO-LD context would re-map value to qudt:value on the PropertyValue node; the full OO-LD instance rides as a File part with its own context for lossless resolution (storage mode B).
